notablePrerequisites:
Naga Fleshcrafter is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Naga Fleshcrafter do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Naga Fleshcrafter.
Activate Naga Fleshcrafter by tapping it.
When Naga Fleshcrafter becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Naga Fleshcrafter's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
